execution_modes.cryptographic_execution: Execute the scoped test or verifier against pinned implementations and evidence.
execution_modes.evidence_only_reverification: Re-hash and re-evaluate frozen evidence without performing new cryptographic execution.
execution_modes.external_review_handoff: Provide the contracts, assumptions, outputs, and evidence bindings required for an outside reviewer to evaluate the model.

execution_phases.action: Identify the package, repository, artifact, firmware, hardware-backed component, or cryptographic implementation whose readiness claim is being assessed.
execution_phases.name: target_selection

execution_phases.action: Bind the target and all evidence to immutable source revisions and/or cryptographic digests.
execution_phases.name: immutable_identity_binding

execution_phases.action: Verify hashes and expected identities before execution.
execution_phases.name: input_integrity_verification

execution_phases.action: Record the runtime, implementation versions or commits, provider/module context, and execution environment needed to interpret the result.
execution_phases.name: environment_capture

execution_phases.action: Execute the declared verification profile or reverify previously frozen evidence.
execution_phases.name: scoped_execution

execution_phases.action: Generate machine-readable normalized results with deterministic field semantics.
execution_phases.name: canonical_result_generation

execution_phases.action: Compare expected behavior, implementation behavior, and cross-implementation behavior without silently collapsing semantic differences.
execution_phases.name: comparison_and_mismatch_classification

execution_phases.action: Issue only the decision justified by the evidence; unresolved mismatches, missing bindings, or failed invariants prevent an acceptance claim.
execution_phases.name: fail_closed_decision

execution_phases.action: Publish only the safe evidence subset and preserve explicit non-claims and private-material boundaries.
execution_phases.name: evidence_publication_or_handoff

intended_runners.purpose: Reproduce and inspect evidence before publication.
Execute deterministic verification under an automated environment.
Re-run the same verifier and compare results without relying on the original developer's conclusion.

purpose: Define how QSP is run, by whom, against what target, and how reproducible evidence is produced for external PQC readiness review.
title: PQC Readiness Evidence Execution Context

tool_role.description: QSP binds a scoped PQC readiness claim to immutable target identity, evidence identity, implementation identity, execution context, machine-readable results, and fail-closed decision semantics.
